verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a coding agent with task history and account data, so the axis applies. The pack documents no export feature or open-format data dump. The 'never locked in' pricing claim (cline-docs-15) is about switching model providers or self-hosting, which is an adjacent capability and not data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
